how_to_add: Put a woman's photos in public/beforeafter/<id>/ (before, 3 to 5 steps, after; same woman, same light, same angle; 4:5 portrait, no text), add an entry below, and set enabled to true. Example entry: {"id": "amara", "name": "Soft glam", "before": "before.webp", "steps": [{"name": "Skin prep", "image": "step-1.webp", "routine": "skin"}, {"name": "Base", "image": "step-2.webp", "routine": "complexion"}, {"name": "Eyes", "image": "step-3.webp", "routine": "eyes"}], "after": "after.webp"}. Allowed routine ids: skin, complexion, eyes, brow_kohl, lips, glow.
